item.text: I’ll work on snapshot delivery to a delayed service consumer. Raft updates its snapshot state before the service reads the application channel, so I’ll check whether a newer resident snapshot can invalidate an earlier queued snapshot and leave a gap before queued commands. I’ll build a test using real elections and RPCs before changing that behavior.

item.text: The new test reproduced an executable bug: after snapshots 1 and 3 were queued, `cond_install_snapshot` rejected snapshot 1 because snapshot 3 was already resident. The consumer then received command 2 with its applied cursor still at zero. I’m changing installation authorization to use the exact pending delivery, so later compaction cannot invalidate an already queued prefix.
